paragraphs: STQRY, formerly OnCell, is a storytelling platform used to create location-based tours, virtual tours, mobile and web apps, audio guides, games, and online collections. Images, audio, text and map information are added to a mobile guide app through a web-based tour builder. Tours built in STQRY Apps can be tested and published for mobile web, iOS and Android. Content in a published tour or audio guide can be changed later through the STQRY builder, with updates pushed to the app in real time.

STQRY Kiosk is a separate platform for creating digital labels and interactive storytelling elements for visitors. Kiosk content is offered in 30 different languages, including Arabic, Hebrew, Māori and Papiamento.

The about page dates the business to OnCell's inception in 2006 and describes the destinations served as museums, parks, cities, and historic sites. The apps pricing section states that a setup fee of USD 1,995 applies for native apps.

quote.text: The simple to use app builder for interactive visitor experiences.
